title: Insights into the mechanism of 3d transition-metal-catalyzed directed C(sp3)–H bond functionalization reactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,4353-4390
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00657G, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Andrés García-Viada, Juan C. Carretero, Javier Adrio, Nuria Rodríguez
This review provides an overview of the research advaces in Ni-, Cu-, Fe- and Co-catalyzed directed C(sp3)–H bond functionalization reactions; including design principles, mechanistic discussions, along with potential applications and limitations.
